MOD_CONST = 1000000007

def mod_pow(base, exp):
    if exp == 1:
        return base
    half = mod_pow(base, exp // 2)
    val = (half * half) % MOD_CONST
    if exp % 2 == 0:
        return val
    return (val * base) % MOD_CONST
